title: The Town Mouse and the Country Mouse
summary: Two mice visit each other and learn that a quiet home can be better than a rich but scary one.

source.author: Aesop
source.note: Retold from the plot of the fable in new A2 English by Lexkite; no sentences copied from any translation.

license: Adaptation CC BY 4.0 Lexkite; original fable in the public domain

cover.scene: Flat 2D illustration: a small grey mouse at a cosy field home and a city mouse beside a grand table with cheese, warm colours, no text

chapters.title: A Visit to the Country
sentences: A little mouse lived in a quiet field.
His home was small, but it was warm.
He ate simple food like nuts and seeds.
One day, his cousin came from the town.
The country mouse was happy to see him.
He gave his cousin the best food he had.
The town mouse looked at the plate with sad eyes.
"This food is very plain," he said.
"Come to my house in town.
You will eat like a king."
The country mouse thought about it and agreed.

quiz.q: Where did the first mouse live?
quiz.explain: He lived in a quiet field.

quiz.q: What did the country mouse eat?
quiz.explain: He ate simple food like nuts and seeds.

quiz.q: Why did the town mouse invite his cousin?
options: He wanted to show better food.
quiz.explain: He said his cousin would eat like a king in town.

chapters.title: A Rich but Scary Home
sentences: The town house was big and beautiful.
There was bread, cheese and sweet cake on the table.
The country mouse had never seen so much food.
He sat down and began to eat.
Suddenly, the door opened with a loud noise.
A cat ran into the room!
The mice ran and hid in a small hole.
Their hearts beat very fast.
Later, the country mouse stood up.
"Your food is wonderful," he said.
"But I am afraid all the time here.
I prefer my simple life at home."
He went back to the quiet field and felt safe.

quiz.explain: A cat ran into the room, and the mice hid.
They ran and hid in a small hole.

quiz.q: What does the country mouse decide?
options: To go home to his simple life
quiz.explain: He prefers his simple, safe life in the field.
